Raj Patel: Heads up  next week's all-hands Thu 10am PT. We're doing a 30m rapid format. Drop 1-2 bullets if you want a slot.

Raj Patel: Draft agenda:
• 4m - company health + headcount pulse
• 6m - Redwood Optimize public beta launch callouts (product)
• 6m - runtime perf wins + cost wins (eng)
• 4m - security & compliance note (GRC)
• 10m - Q&A (collected + live)

Emily Wong: Logistics: hybrid room D + Zoom, captions on. Slides -> https://drive.reddoc/teams/allhands/briefs (one pager please).

Marco Ruiz: For Optimize beta I'll do a 60s screencast showing the new batching tuner.

Priya Singh: Will session be recorded? I need to clear a short customer anecdote first.

Clara Gomez: Recording is on by default. We'll post the full recording plus a 2-3min highlight clip in #all-hands-posts. Flag any segments for hold before Wed EOD.

Nora Feldman: Security note: we'll briefly mention an update to third-party model vetting guidance (minor, internal). If teams want more detail we'll host a follow-up office hours next week.

Raj Patel: Good. Clara can you add a one-line pointer to the follow-up office hours in the post?

Clara Gomez: Yep. I'll include the office hours RSVP link and a short blurb with the recording.

All-Hands Bot: Reminder scheduled - "All-Hands: Thu 10am PT" will post 24h and 1h before.

Raj Patel: Q&A collection form: https://forms.reddoc/allhands-questions. Please submit top questions by Wed 5pm so we can triage.

Emily Wong: Also ordering in-office lunch for the room; dietary form here: https://tinyurl.com/redwood-lunch-opts by Tue noon.

Marco Ruiz: I'll upload the screencast + 1-slide summary by Wed COB.

Raj Patel: Thanks team  keep asks brief. See you Thursday. :rocket:
